messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] P1: routing.policy_failure detected for policy=eu-fallback. Error rate spiked to 43% over 2m; large surge to model variant eu-west-1-quantized-v2. See /runbooks/smart-routing and incident dashboard: https://console.internal/insights/1769154321

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: mike (oncall) has been paged (ack required) :rotating_light:

mike (oncall): acked. joining. seeing traffic doubling on the eu fallback pool, high OOM / connection resets. what's the customer impact?

aj (runtime): TL;DR: routing policy mis-match + aggressive client retries. The fallback policy allowed a non-compatible variant (quantized-v2) for some traffic shape; when the original region transiently hit capacity we routed ~80% of new requests to eu-west-1-quantized-v2 which is heavier in startup mem and sometimes OOMs -> those requests return 5xx quickly -> clients retry immediately -> we spin up more failover and amplify. looks like exponential retry with small base on a few clients.

sara (sre): on it. can someone post the exact policy delta from last deploy? want the git diff for routing config.

aj (runtime): putting diff now: 
```
- fallback_variants: [eu-west-1-quantized-v1]
+ fallback_variants: [eu-west-1-quantized-v2, eu-west-1-quantized-v1]
+ allow_variant_on_high_latency: true
```
The new commit allowed quantized-v2 in the policy; it wasn't validated for short-seq workloads.

shivani (infra): infra metrics: node spinups in eu-west-1 hit quota then started queuing, autoscaler began rebalancing -> some nodes crashed (OOM) and we started failing requests. Also seeing cross-region egress spike to eu-west-1 from us-east-1.

mike (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) stop routing to eu-west-1-quantized-v2 2) throttle retries at the LB edge 3) inform customers and advise temporary client backoff config. who's actioning 1?

aj (runtime): I can flip the policy weight to 0 for that variant via the admin API. executing now:
```
curl -X POST https://api.internal/redwood/routing/update
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED"
  -d '{"policy":"eu-fallback","variant_weights":{"eu-west-1-quantized-v2":0}}'
```

aj (runtime): update submitted, waiting for propagation.

incident-bot: Action logged: routing change requested by aj (runtime). Change id: CHG-20260315-847.

sara (sre): while that propagates, enable an edge-level retry-suppress rule to coalesce retries for 30s window. I can push an emergency rate-limiter patch to the gateway. Anyone object?

shivani (infra): go ahead. I'll watch autoscaler and kill unhealthy nodes in eu-west-1 pool. also raising temporary capacity increases in adjacent zones.

mike (oncall): eva, please draft a short customer note for affected customers and CS. luis, get me a list of top 5 tenants affected. we need to know SLA hit potential.

eva (eng): on it. draft: "We're investigating elevated errors affecting generation requests routed to EU fallback. We've applied an emergency mitigation and expect service recovery within 20-30m. We're also advising clients to add 500ms+ jittered backoff for retries." will post after review.

luis (cs): pulling list now — looks like three high-volume customers saw a 20-60% error spike, others minor. pinging account owners.

aj (runtime): routing change propagated across control plane (approx 8s). telemetry shows a drop in new sessions routed to eu-west-1-quantized-v2 from ~78% -> ~2%.

pagerduty-bot: mike (oncall) acknowledged the alert.

mike (oncall): seeing error rate drop but still a small tail of retries. Sara, did the gateway coalescing land?

sara (sre): yes deployed: added retry suppress + request hash de-dup window 25s for identical request ID signatures. Also added a temporary circuit-breaker to mark variant unhealthy for 1m if >20% errors.

shivani (infra): unhealthy instance kill loop stopped, autoscaler stabilized. CPU/mem back to normal. network egress dropped 62%.

cheng (product): we should block new policy commits that add variants without runbook validation. created a quick policy: policy-guard to require engineering signoff for variant promotions.

aj (runtime): log sample from failing nodes that explains client side retry amplification: many clients were returning with 502 then immediate retry. example snippet: 
```
[2026-03-15T14:04:12Z] request_id=abc123 status=502 latency=12ms
[2026-03-15T14:04:12Z] client_retry attempt=1 backoff_ms=50
[2026-03-15T14:04:12Z] request_id=abc124 status=502 latency=15ms
[2026-03-15T14:04:12Z] client_retry attempt=1 backoff_ms=50
```
We need to update client SDK default backoff and publish guidance.

mike (oncall): customer impact: three tenants hit noticeable error rates; tentative SLA exposure for 45m window. Eva, can you coordinate the incident summary for CS?

eva (eng): will send to CS within 25m. Drafting impact blurb with timeline and mitigation steps.

luis (cs): forwarded the draft to customers, got one reply asking for root-cause and whether data was lost — replying that no user data was lost, only transient failures.

sara (sre): next steps / action items: 
- aj: revert policy change and add integration test for variant compatibility (ETA: 1d)
- cheng: gate on policy promotion and add checklist (ETA: 2d)
- devex: publish client retry guidance and bump SDK default backoff (ETA: 3d)
- infra (shivani): add autoscaler guardrails and soft quotas (ETA: 2d)
- ops (sara): write postmortem and runbook update (ETA: 48h)

aj (runtime): noted. I'll open a PR for integration test + revert commit now.

mike (oncall): closing P1? error rate is down to baseline and all mitigations applied. keeping this channel open until postmortem created. Great response y'all. :trophy:

incident-bot: Incident P1 resolved - mitigation successful. Please follow postmortem runbook and tag with "smart-routing-fallback" and "retry-amplification".

sara (sre): I'll own the postmortem. created task PM-3421 and assigned. Will include timeline, misconfig diff, client retry analysis, and remediation.

cheng (product): also adding a new policy validation job into CI to detect variant capability mismatches before promotion.

mike (oncall): thanks team. final note: add a customer-facing RCA summary once PM done.

luis (cs): customers acknowledged the update and asked for ETA on SDK guidance. I'll loop back to devex once you publish.

sara (sre): end of thread for now — moving to postmortem doc.
